Thanks for taking the time to contribute! :gift:

Please follow these steps:

1. work on the right branch: it must be `develop` for new features and `master` for hotfixes
1. make sure the feature you add is not listed in [banned features](https://github.com/keeweb/keeweb/wiki/Unsupported-Features)
1. check compatibility with [the project roadmap](https://github.com/keeweb/keeweb/wiki/TODO) and key features: you should not break anything
1. if your feature is introducing a lot of new UI or changing any UX or design concept, please open an issue to discuss it first
1. please respect existing style in code, styles, and markup (hint: install and enable [editorconfig](http://editorconfig.org/) in your editor)
1. don't add any dependencies
1. test your code: it must work in all browsers, Windows, OSX, and Linux
1. if your code is platform-dependent, please add corresponding switches
1. respect each platform: don't create a behaviour that breaks interface guidelines or user expectations
1. run `grunt` and make sure it's passing
1. replace this message with the actual description
